title: The Vatican archives head knows about the hidden material; letters asking access for President Carter

I contacted the Vatican uh and asked if they would let us give me access to the to the archives uh and they said no
tellings.difference: Adds that the Vatican said no and dates the request to 1977.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Sheehan asking the Vatican archives for access on Carter's behalf.

as_told.title: Vatican refuses access to its archives on UFOs

plain: The head of the Vatican archives knows about material hidden there, says a man named Dan Sheehan, because Sheehan himself sent letters from Jesuit headquarters asking that President Jimmy Carter be given access. Sheehan tells Michels he made the request in 1977 and that the Vatican said no. To him, the refusal shows the people in charge know what the archives hold.
